subject.title: Feature: Telegram Reactions - Two-Way Support with Prompt Guidance

question: Should Telegram reaction prompt guidance stay derived from `reactionLevel`, or should sending guidance and incoming-reaction interpretation become separate explicit controls?
rationale: Current main already uses `reactionLevel` for outbound guidance, while the request adds an overlapping config and new default prompt behavior; repository policy makes that config and UX contract a maintainer decision.

options.title: Extend reactionLevel
options.body: Keep one control and add notification-gated incoming soft-CTA guidance for the existing minimal and extensive modes.

options.title: Split send and receive controls
options.body: Add separate explicit settings with documented composition, defaults, generated metadata, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Retain outbound guidance only
options.body: Keep current sending guidance and decline model-level interpretation of incoming reactions.

recommendation.title: Extend reactionLevel
recommendation.body: Keep one control and add notification-gated incoming soft-CTA guidance for the existing minimal and extensive modes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the most recent detailed product-level review of the exact unresolved config and prompt contract.
